## Sep 13 Results: The Numbers Don't Lie

Let's cut straight to what matters: 10 wins, 5 losses, 66.7% accuracy. That's exactly the kind of performance our model is built to deliver consistently. When you're hitting above 65%, you're not getting lucky—you're following the data.

## Performance Breakdown: Game-by-Game Analysis

The high-confidence picks delivered. Our three 63% probability picks went 2-1, and the 61% tier went 3-1. That's a combined 5-2 record on picks above 60% confidence—exactly where you want to see strength.

## The Misses: What the Data Tells Us

Three losses, all worth examining. The Dodgers at 62% was our highest-confidence miss—sometimes variance hits your best picks. The Brewers loss at 63% and Braves at 53% round out the misses. At a 66.7% hit rate, three losses in fifteen games is mathematically on target. This is why we trust volume over single-game outcomes.

## Sep 14 Preview: Tomorrow's Top Pick

Now let's talk about Sep 14. The model has identified a 63% confidence play that checks every box: elite pitching matchup, strong team metrics, and favorable situational factors.

## Breaking Down the Dodgers Pick

Look at this matchup: Tarik Skubal on the mound for the Dodgers against Nick Lodolo. When you've got a pitcher of Skubal's caliber—and the Dodgers' offensive depth—going up against Cincinnati, the numbers favor LA significantly.

The 63% confidence level puts this in our high-probability tier, the same range that went 2-1 yesterday. This is exactly the type of edge we're looking for: clear pitching advantage, strong team fundamentals, and a probability that reflects genuine value.

**Key metrics supporting this pick:**
- Dodgers' road performance vs Reds' home splits
- Skubal's recent form and strikeout metrics
- Cincinnati's struggles against elite left-handed pitching
- Bullpen depth advantage favoring LA

When the model gives you 63% confidence with this supporting data, you take it.

## The Bottom Line

66.7% on Sep 13 keeps us right where we need to be. Sep 14 brings a 63% confidence Dodgers pick that aligns with our winning formula. The data is clear, the edge is real, and the results continue to validate the model.

Stay disciplined, trust the numbers, and let's keep building on this performance.
